invoice.source.intro: This help maps the application to its Zelyra source files. Pages can be written directly or generated from declarations.
invoice.source.main: Connects the modules and explicitly declares the home page with page "/".
invoice.source.shell: Defines the shared AppShell with header, navigation, and footer. Handwritten and generated pages use the same layout.
invoice.source.database: Contains the table and field definitions. Zelyra checks related SQL queries and builds the database schema from them.
invoice.source.catalogs: The CRUD declarations generate lists, search, forms, detail pages, and safe actions for customers and items.
invoice.source.invoices: Defines invoice fields, validation, and automatic numbering. crud Invoice -> invoices generates /invoices and /invoices/new among other routes.
invoice.source.dashboard: The typed SQL projection and tableview InvoiceDashboard generate the overview at /views/invoicedashboard.
invoice.source.theme: Centrally controls colors, spacing, and project component styles. Zelyra UI supplies the base; this file needs no CDN or frontend build.
invoice.source.next: Open the source files in the editor. Check the project with zelyra check main.zyl and start the web server with zelyra serve main.zyl.
